name: Ripperdoc Ticket
description: (Tag:tech)(Tag:ticket)(Tech) A ticket that transfers you to a mechanical Ripperdoc's clinic to install Cyberpunk 2077 implants or ones you bring, for the right price. His top-quality wares are expensive and may require bartering. You return upon leaving, can spend only 24 hours inside, and Restock Timer: 15 Days.
